From our bakery

Photos from ASTRY and from guests in the Google listing.

A bakery under an olive tree

ASTRY is on Anexartisias, the busy shopping street of Limassol. Inside, an olive tree grows over long wooden tables, and behind the glass you can see the bakery and the shelves of bread. Guests come for breakfast and brunch, to work with coffee, or for a glass of wine in the evening, and some take a loaf of bread home. On Google they praise the bread, the pistachio pastries, the Basque cheesecake and the tiramisu, the coffee and matcha, and the friendly team. There is also seating outside, and dogs are welcome inside.

Open every day from 8:30 to 21:00, on Fridays and Saturdays until 23:00. Brunch until 16:00, dinner after 18:00.
